title: Beyond Matching: OTHERS, Directional Weak-Evidence Scoring, and Reputational Intelligence
description: This research repository proposes an open scoring framework for evidence that cannot yet be fully represented by formal feature matching or conventional distance metrics. It introduces OTHERS as a model-relative open evidence space, Directional Measurement Sails as a candidate mechanism for aggregating heterogeneous weak signals, and reputational and collective weak-signal intelligence as related applications. The framework distinguishes evidence scoring, perspective-dependent interpretation, and authorized action selection, while outlining counter-evidence, provenance, governance, and pathways from provisional signals to validated structural knowledge. Version 1.0.0 presents conceptual and algorithmic proposals and a validation agenda; it does not claim experimentally established performance improvements.
notes: Conceptual research release. No empirical performance claims are made. AI assistance is credited in the repository documentation.
